messages:
ela: small design check playground streaming behavior. options: compact stop overlay, inline regenerate only in footer, lightweight token pill, and a 5s accessible toast with undo. thoughts?

toni: prefer overlay stop on desktop to avoid reflow. show a subtle 'partial' badge while streaming. mobile: fallback to an inline 'Stop stream' action.

sam: engineering: overlay is straightforward. we'll make touch target 40px and set pointer-events to avoid breaking text selection. token pill updates will be throttled to 250ms.

priya: a11y: use a per-message aria-live="polite" live region. on stop move focus to the toast undo button and announce 'Streaming paused; undo to resume.' Ensure undo has aria-label='Resume stream' and the toast uses role=status.

toni: copy: change label from 'Stop' to 'Stop stream'. toast: "Stream paused  Undo". token pill should read "~120 tokens" while streaming and full breakdown in tooltip.

ela: UX trade: if undo resumes, do we append new tokens or replay? prefer resume append so users don't lose context. add a tiny marker where resume starts.

sam: implementation: try resume from cached KV; if not available, re-run with same params and tag analytics as restart. will expose resumeStreaming(msgId) API.

priya: screen reader note: when resuming set aria-atomic="false" on the resumed segment so only new text is read. also test that resumed content doesn't trigger full re-read.

ela: plan: sam to prototype overlay + throttled counter this sprint, toni to update mocks for desktop/mobile, priya to draft a11y test cases. quick review Friday 11am PT. thanks :thumbsup:
design-bot: design reminder: include motion-reduce alternative for overlay animations before merge.
